title: Organizations
description: Every tenant in the system, personal and team. Staff are never members of one.

slug.label: Address
slug.description: Lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens. It appears in the customer app's URLs.

ownerId.label: Owner
ownerId.description: The account that will own it. Staff are never members, so an organization created here needs an owner named.

create.title: New organization
create.description: Creates a team organization owned by the account you name. A personal organization is created with its account and cannot be made here.

edit.title: Edit {{name}}
edit.description: Name and address are all an organization has. Its kind never changes, and a personal organization keeps the address derived from its account.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: The organization is hidden and its address is released for reuse. Its members and invitations survive but reach nothing. A personal organization cannot be deleted on its own.

bulkDelete.description: Each is hidden and releases its address. Personal organizations are refused and reported individually.

members.title: Members
members.description: Who belongs to this organization, and as what. Adding somebody here is the one way into an organization that does not go through an invitation.

add.title: Add a member
add.description: By account id, because staff already have the list of accounts to find one in.
add.userIdDescription: The id of the account to add.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.description: They lose access to this organization immediately. The last owner cannot be removed.
